name: Streamex Gold Yield
oneLiner: GLDY is Streamex's tokenized gold ounce on Base, backed by physical bullion and gold-leasing receivables with Chainlink Proof of Reserve.
collateral: Physical gold bullion backing with issuer-managed gold leasing through Monetary Metals; Streamex presents one GLDY as one troy ounce of gold exposure with yield paid in additional gold
pegMechanism: Commodity-backed gold token with Chainlink proof-of-reserves on Base; eligible primary-market investors can redeem through the issuer process, while secondary markets price the gold-ounce claim plus accrued yield mechanics

mintAuthority.summary: GLDY is issued by Streamex Ltd (a Cayman open-ended fund) as a gold-backed tokenized security; tokens are minted and credited to accredited/institutional investors only after KYC, subscription signing, and fund settlement, through the issuer's compliance-gated process.

controls.label: Streamex Ltd issuance backend (compliance-gated)
controls.evidence: Streamex mints GLDY only after investors complete KYC, sign subscription documents, fund, and the gold purchase settles; mint/redeem is operationally serviced by the issuer (with market makers for instant mint/redeem). Supply is issuer-controlled with no permissionless route.

review.evidence: Streamex launch materials and coverage describe a compliance-gated issuer mint for accredited investors (Cayman open-ended fund, $25k minimum), with Chainlink PoR over physical gold; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classification based on the issuer/fund model in launch materials and coverage; the on-chain Base owner/minter admin for GLDY was not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain Base owner/minter admin for GLDY before raising confidence.
